description: x402-open-interest: Open interest for a perpetual, read from two venues at once and reported in contracts and USD, with the change over the last N hours. Open interest is the size of the position book — it says whether a move is being built or unwound, which price alone cannot tell you. Per venue: current open interest, its USD value, the % change over the window, plus mark price and funding rate where the venue publishes them.
name: x402-open-interest
